title: Remediation Planning — Final Coordination

fields.headline: Final Remediation Plan Directive
fields.narration: The airport’s leadership team has convened for a final emergency session. You are now directed to produce a unified remediation plan covering all critical areas. The plan must include: revised access control procedures under ASP Section 6.4; a new, encrypted storage policy for all SSI documents; a full replacement of the shared local account workstation (SECWS-02) by end of week; a new 24-hour audit log for all access to the SSI repository; and a formal submission of the revised Airport Security Program to TSA by 8:00 AM Friday, October 23, 2026. The 11 PM Channel 5 follow-up is airing in 13 minutes — your public statement must be ready.
keyFacts: The revised ASP must be submitted to TSA by 8:00 AM Friday, October 23, 2026.
All SSI documents must be stored in an encrypted, access-controlled repository on SEC-SVR-01.
SECWS-02 (shared workstation in Security office) must be replaced by EOD Friday.
The new access log for SSI files must include full authentication and timestamping.
The public statement for Channel 5’s 11 PM follow-up must be finalized within 15 minutes.
fields.expectedAction: Each team must provide a written, time-bound remediation proposal. The Operations Director will compile them into a single executive summary for the TSA Compliance Team.
fields.facilitatorNote: After reading, display the ICS 201 form on the screen, showing the 'actions' and 'resource' columns. Use it to prompt teams to assign timelines and responsible roles.

instructorNote: This inject closes the scenario. The players must now deliver a full, time-bound remediation plan. Push for specific dates and responsible roles.
